summary.tldr: Ends copyright in works prepared or published by the Crown or federal departments, and ends existing copyright in those works when the bill starts.
what_it_does: Replaces section 12 of the Copyright Act so that no copyright exists in any work prepared or published by or under the direction or control of His Majesty or a government department.
Ends any existing copyright in those covered works on the day the bill comes into force.
who_it_affects: People and businesses using government works
